short_description: Overview: Vega Insta Glam 1000W Hair Dryer (VHDH-20) is a compact, everyday hair dryer designed for quick drying and simple styling at home or on the go. The lightweight body, foldable handle and detachable nozzle make it easy to store, carry and use in...
description:
Overview: Vega Insta Glam 1000W Hair Dryer (VHDH-20) is a compact, everyday hair dryer designed for quick drying and simple styling at home or on the go. The lightweight body, foldable handle and detachable nozzle make it easy to store, carry and use in tight spaces.

Performance & Settings: With 1000 watts of power and 2 heat/speed settings, you can choose a gentler airflow for touch-ups or a higher setting for quicker drying on damp hair. The concentrator nozzle helps direct airflow where you need it for smoother finishes and basic styling.

Technology & Safety: The dryer runs on corded electric power and features an overheat cut-out for added safety during regular use. A comfortable handle and practical cord length support short, everyday drying sessions.

Ideal Usage Scenario: This model is suited for users who want a simple, reliable hair dryer for drying and basic styling rather than heavy, salon-style blowouts. It works well for daily routines, travel and quick fixes before work, events or outings.

Design & Convenience: The pink and white colour combination, foldable handle and compact form factor make it easy to fit into drawers, gym bags or suitcases. The detachable nozzle and included accessories help keep the dryer versatile yet straightforward to use.
